questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The only reason for why i do not rate the experience 10 is that the bidding system at NOVA SBE did not work optimal. questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It's not that the bidding platform does not work optimally but the students are granted different amount of points. The amount differes A LOT. As an Erasmus exchange student we only get 150 points to bid on 5-9 courses while other students have 600 points to bid on 1-3 courses. This means that it is almost impossible to get a spot on the popular courses and the courses you want. I ended up having to attend courses not relevant for my studies just so that I could get the 31,5 ECTS point that I needed. Exchange students should be informed about this since it effects our education and our opportunities to specialize in the area that we wish.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You are granted points that you then distribute on the courses you wish to attend. If you get a spot some point will be given back to you. If you do net get a spot you get all the points back and then bid again in the second round. This is done over several bidding rounds.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: A support email

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Given that Erasmus studends did not have nearly as many points as many of the other master students at NOVA it was very difficult to register/bid successfully.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Really spend time to get familiar with the bidding platform and the deadlines
